about_the_game:
About Sisyphus journey: 

In this game you will have one purpose - push the stone to a top of the mountain. Gather your strength, make friends, set up and develop your camp, come across four different locations to achieve your goal!

But why should you do this? 

You're dead. It was not the most beautiful life and not the most beautiful death. But God is witness to this - you tried your best, even though you got confused along the way.

But death was not the end of your journey. Now you are... cursed. The world in which you find yourself was created in order to teach you something. Or not? Maybe it has no meaning, just like your whole life.

Your burden is to push a huge stone to the top of the mountain. For what? No one has given you the answer to this question, but you have no choice. Here you cannot die and your suffering will never end. 

Complete this journey: 

  • meet lost souls like you

  • set up your camp

  • find meaning in what is happening

  • make a fateful decision and make the cursed world crumbles or prosper

Do not be afraid, with a great purpose comes great outcomes!

short_description: What happens after death? Someone claims they know, someone says they don't. But we know what will happen to Sisyphus. Take this journey and find yourself in it. Will you save yourself or others? We will find out when the stone wiil be at the top.
